svg.title: Reading the 1-2 F_T chart (Kern Fig. 18 / Holman Fig. 10-8) at R = 15
svg.text: Reading the 1-2 F_T chart (Kern Fig. 18 / Holman Fig. 10-8) at R = 15
1 shell pass, even number of tube passes; redrawn from the exact formula; right: zoom of 0 ≤ S ≤ 0.15
R = 15, S = 0.0625: the reading sits at the far left of the chart, so it is shown on the zoom (right).
Mark S = 0.0625 on the zoom’s bottom axis and go straight up to the R = 15 curve.
Go across to the F_T axis of the zoom.
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
